_doc: Procurement-family links that a contract's own signed text cannot supply, because it cites its πρόσκληση and κατακύρωση by DATE only, while the ΑΔΑΜ are established by the family's other documents. Each row keeps the citing sentence of the contract AND names the document that supplies the ΑΔΑΜ; families_loader appends these with source «curated». Never inferred from a name, a date alone or a contractor (DATA_DECISIONS 2026-09-01).
